label: Portainer environment interoperability
summary: Prepare selected Portainer environment inventory and explicitly scoped interoperability through an admitted Core integration.
core_boundary: Portainer-managed resources remain externally owned until an explicit import/handoff is authorized. Its Docker/Kubernetes proxy is not delegated to the plugin; native Core Docker controls remain free. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Qualify a selected Portainer product/API profile with per-user token permissions, exact environment/team/resource ownership and bounded redacted inventory.
Refuse raw Docker/Kubernetes passthrough, arbitrary stack/Compose inputs and mutation of resources actively controlled by Core; any operation needs a separate admitted use case.
Exercise revoked access, stale inventory, partial external changes and retained-volume recovery; disabling the connector must not remove environments or stop hosted workloads.

Declare observation-only, import or externally managed ownership before any integration request. Refuse competing writers for Core-owned resources; ownership handoff requires an authorized inventory, admission review and recovery plan.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
